outcome_detail: Civil suit active as of November 2025; no statement of defence had been filed at that time. Statement of claim seeks $1.5 million in damages.
criminal_detail: In November 2025, following an ASIRT investigation opened in September 2023, Const. Renzo Geronimo was charged with sexual assault, unlawful confinement, being unlawfully in a dwelling house, and breach of trust. He was released on an undertaking, suspended without pay, and scheduled for a first court appearance on Dec. 10, 2025. No trial outcome reported as of July 2026.
description: A statement of claim filed in April 2025 alleges that in August 2023 an on-duty Edmonton Police Service officer in a marked cruiser followed a 25-year-old woman home from a 7-Eleven/gas station on Edmonton's south side, pulled her over, and later forcibly groped her, including entering her dwelling. Because the officer's identity was not then known to the plaintiff, the suit named then-chief Dale McFee and an officer identified only as 'John Doe,' and seeks $1.5 million in damages. In November 2025, the Alberta Serious Incident Response Team charged Const. Renzo Geronimo with sexual assault, unlawful confinement, being unlawfully in a dwelling house, and breach of trust; the plaintiff's lawyer said the charges relate to the same circumstances as the civil suit. Geronimo, a five-year veteran, was suspended without pay. The civil allegations have not been tested in court, and the criminal charges have not been proven.
notes: Slug year (2023) reflects the incident year; the civil statement of claim was filed in April 2025.
